_meta.description: Geopolitical and macro events that affect NLP scoring weight for Trump Truth Social posts. Status and priority determine how much weight a post referencing related accounts/assets should receive.

status_values.escalating: Recently intensified — higher weight than baseline active (weight 1.3)
status_values.paused: Temporary ceasefire, truce, or negotiation in effect (weight 0.4)
status_values.monitoring: Dormant but not formally resolved; watching for reactivation (weight 0.2)
status_values.ended: De facto concluded with no formal agreement; precedent risk remains (weight 0.1)
status_values.resolved: Formally concluded with signed agreement or declared end (weight 0.05)

priority_values.high: Direct US market impact or active military/economic crisis (multiplier 1.0)
priority_values.medium: Significant regional impact or indirect US exposure (multiplier 0.6)
priority_values.low: Dormant, precedent-only, or minor market relevance (multiplier 0.3)

_meta.scoring_note: Final event weight = status_weight * priority_multiplier. For a given Truth Social post, use the max weight across all events affecting the mentioned accounts.

events.name: Russia-Ukraine War
events.description: Full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine. Active front lines, ongoing Western military aid, and periodic ceasefire negotiations. Direct market impact on oil, gas, wheat, defense stocks, and EUR.
events.notes: Ceasefire negotiations ongoing via US/EU mediators. Status may shift to 'paused' if a formal ceasefire is declared.

events.name: US-China Tariff War
events.description: Trump's Liberation Day tariffs (April 2025) triggered US-China trade war escalation to 145% tariffs. 90-day truce announced May 12 2025, tariffs reduced to 30%. Structural tech/trade tensions remain unresolved.
events.notes: 90-day truce began 2025-05-12. Broader decoupling trend continues. Status should revert to 'active' or 'escalating' if truce expires without deal.

events.name: Israel-Gaza War
events.description: Hamas attack on Israel on Oct 7 2023, followed by prolonged Israeli military campaign in Gaza. Regional spillover into Lebanon, Yemen (Houthi attacks), and Iran-Israel direct exchanges.
events.notes: Ongoing ground operations and hostage negotiations. Houthi Red Sea attacks affect global shipping. Status may change based on hostage deal progress.

events.name: Iran Tensions / Strait of Hormuz
events.description: Iran-Israel direct exchange of fire began April 2024. Strait of Hormuz remains a chokepoint for ~20% of global oil. Iran nuclear program continues. US-Iran negotiations on-and-off.
events.notes: Strait closure scenario would be a black-swan oil shock. Monitor for nuclear deal progress or military escalation signals.

events.name: US-China Technology / Semiconductor War
events.description: US export controls on advanced chips and semiconductor equipment to China (Oct 2022, expanded 2023-2025). Covers AI chips (NVIDIA H100/H200), EDA tools, and chip manufacturing equipment. China countermeasures include rare earth export restrictions.
events.notes: Distinct from tariff war — this is about technology access and national security. Likely to persist regardless of tariff negotiations.

events.name: AI Technology Disruption
events.description: Rapid AI deployment driving stock market concentration in AI infrastructure companies (NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL, META). AI governance debates, job displacement fears, and AI arms race between US and China. Geopolitical statements about AI regulation or AI weapons can move markets.
events.notes: AI-related geopolitical announcements (chip export controls, AI weapons bans, sovereign AI initiatives) increasingly market-moving.

events.name: Russia Energy Sanctions
events.description: Western sanctions on Russian oil, gas, and financial system following Ukraine invasion. EU energy decoupling from Russia largely complete. Price cap on Russian oil ($60/barrel) remains in effect. Sanctions evasion via third-party countries ongoing.
events.notes: Any signal of sanctions relief (linked to Ukraine peace deal) would be highly market-moving for energy and European equities.

events.name: COVID-19 Pandemic
events.description: Global pandemic declared by WHO Jan 2020, PHEIC ended May 2023. Pandemic-era supply chain disruptions, monetary policy responses, and fiscal stimulus continue to echo in inflation and interest rate environment. Precedent risk: novel pathogen could trigger similar market shock.
events.notes: Low residual weight — keep for precedent scoring if new pandemic signals emerge (novel virus, WHO emergency declarations).

events.name: Taiwan Strait Tensions
events.description: China military exercises around Taiwan intensified after Pelosi's 2022 visit. PLA air incursions into Taiwan ADIZ are routine. Any escalation toward blockade or invasion would be a major semiconductor supply shock (TSMC).
events.notes: Black-swan risk. Currently monitoring — escalate to 'active' or 'escalating' on PLA blockade exercises or major political trigger.

events.name: Mexico-US Border / Fentanyl Crisis
events.description: Trump's second term brought aggressive enforcement: threatened 25% tariffs on Mexico, designation of cartels as terrorist organizations, deportation campaigns. Claudia Sheinbaum negotiations with Trump administration ongoing.
events.notes: US-Mexico tariff threats move MXN significantly. Monitor for cartel designation escalation.

events.name: Armenia-Azerbaijan / Nagorno-Karabakh
events.description: Azerbaijan retook Nagorno-Karabakh in Sept 2023 military operation. Armenian refugees displaced. Pashinyan's Armenia pursuing EU integration as pivot away from Russia. Residual border demarcation disputes remain.
events.notes: Conflict phase over. Monitoring for border incidents or Armenia-EU formal association moves that could provoke Russia.

events.name: Venezuela Political Crisis
events.description: Maduro's disputed 2024 re-election. US sanctions regime in place. Oil sector waivers issued and revoked. Venezuela-US relations tied to migrant flows and oil market access.
events.notes: Low market relevance unless oil production deals or sanction changes are announced. Monitor Maduro-Trump direct exchanges.
